text:
Aria Gomez: hi team, joining today! on an M2 Air — followed the quickstart but my `python` and `node` are still the system ones. installed asdf via brew. any quick triage? :wave:
DevX Bot: welcome Aria! paste outputs: `which python`, `which node`, `echo $PATH`, and whether you use zsh or bash.
Aria Gomez: which python -> /usr/bin/python3, which node -> /usr/local/bin/node, echo $PATH -> /usr/bin:/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/Users/aria/.asdf/shims, using zsh.
Tom: looks like PATH ordering — /opt/homebrew/bin should be earlier and asdf shims need to come before system bins. In ~/.zshrc try:
```
export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$HOME/.asdf/shims:$PATH"
. $(brew --prefix asdf)/libexec/asdf.sh
```
Riley: also check you don't have leftover nvm or pyenv lines. `grep -E "nvm|pyenv" ~/.zshrc` can show that quickly.
Aria Gomez: grep showed `export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"` and `source $NVM_DIR/nvm.sh` from an old setup. removed them and reloaded. `which node` now -> /Users/aria/.asdf/shims/node but `node -v` still shows v14.
Jia: run `asdf plugin-list` and `asdf current` and check .tool-versions in the repo you cloned. To install the right versions: `asdf plugin-add nodejs` then `asdf install nodejs 18.16.0` and `asdf global nodejs 18.16.0` then `asdf reshim`. Note nodejs plugin needs the keyring import on mac: `bash ~/.asdf/plugins/nodejs/bin/import-release-team-keyring` if install errors.
Aria Gomez: did the import, installed node 18.16.0, reshim, node -v -> v18.16.0. thanks!
Tom: for python: `asdf plugin-add python` then `asdf install python 3.11.4` and `asdf global python 3.11.4`. if pipenv/poetry created venvs, check `python -m pip --version` and `which pip` too.
Aria Gomez: installed 3.11.4, but VS Code's terminal still uses the old python. any tips?
Riley: launch VS Code from the terminal (`code .`) so it inherits the shell PATH. Also check the VS Code Python extension interpreter selection — set it to the asdf shim path. Settings: Command Palette -> Python: Select Interpreter -> choose the one under ~/.asdf.
Aria Gomez: great. last question: where are the company dotfiles and pre-commit hooks? want to set git name/email and hooks.
Jia: our repo is https://github.com/redwood-inference/dotfiles — clone and run `./setup.sh`. It symlinks and sets git config. If you want the minimal git config: `git config --global user.name "Aria Gomez" && git config --global user.email "aria@redwood.com"` then run the setup script.
Aria Gomez: cloning and running setup.sh now. thanks everyone! tagging @Tom if anything breaks during setup. :tada:
